responsibility: Implements RTL loop-invariant code motion. For each loop, it analyzes register-defined invariants and their dependence graph, tracks whether expressions are always executed, estimates movement cost and register-pressure impact, chooses profitable invariants to hoist subject to available pressure, and then rewrites the RTL to move selected computations out of the loop while preserving uses and creating temporaries when needed. It is deliberately focused on simpler RTL invariants such as arithmetic and address computations, complementing more aggressive GIMPLE-level PRE and LICM passes.
